### May 20[Direct link to heading](https://help.vectary.com/changelog/may-2026\#may-20-2)

- Fixed issue where [XLOOKUP](https://help.vectary.com/documentation/3d-configurator/variables-and-expressions/functions) function was not working correctly

- Fixed issue where `Append parameters` feature in the [Link action](https://help.vectary.com/documentation/3d-configurator/interactions/actions/link) was not working correctly

- Minor improvements and bug fixes


### May 6[Direct link to heading](https://help.vectary.com/changelog/may-2026\#may-6)

Improvements

Bug fixes

### May 6[Direct link to heading](https://help.vectary.com/changelog/may-2026\#may-6-1)

- Added support for Gaussian Splats (.PLY)

- Added context menu triggered by right-click for importing project from **Workspace** tab

- Improved normal handling during mesh import


### May 6[Direct link to heading](https://help.vectary.com/changelog/may-2026\#may-6-2)

- Fixed issue where linked materials became unlinked in exported models

- Fixed bug preventing changing Smooth threshold value in Edit mode

- Fixed bug with Point light slider when using values above 100%

- Fixed UI bug with incorrect display of purple span in timeline
